# BYZ scope. Calm enough for this line's events (design 3.2): no civil war, no theme revolt, no Byzantine intrigue.
oe_bey_calm = {
    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active }
    oe_bi_active = no
}
# BYZ scope. The Ottomans exist and the house of Osman has not joined the empire (every Ottoman event and step).
oe_bey_ott_ok = { country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } }
# BYZ scope. Can pay $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_bey_can_pay = { gold >= { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }
# Country scope (an emirate). It counts toward the counterweight (牵制, design 3.9): not the Ottomans' subject, on the
# Ottoman border (theirs or a subject's) and not hostile to the empire.
oe_bey_cw_one = {
    country_exists = c:TUR
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    NOT = { tag = TUR }
    NOT = { is_subject_of = c:TUR }
    OR = {
        is_neighbor_of = c:TUR
        any_neighbor_country = { is_subject_of = c:TUR }
    }
    opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 0 }
}

# BYZ scope. Each event's own trigger (also checked when a test button fires it).
oe_bey_ev_1 = { country_exists = c:AYD }
oe_bey_ev_2 = { country_exists = c:AYD }
oe_bey_ev_3 = { country_exists = c:TUR }

# BYZ scope. The monthly check may roll this event (its trigger plus the window and the line's state).
oe_bey_ok_1 = { oe_bey_ev_1 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_1 } var:oe_bey_m >= 28 var:oe_bey_m <= 46 oe_s37_umur_ok = yes country_exists = c:AYD character:ayd_umur ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:AYD } at_war = no }
oe_bey_ok_2 = { oe_bey_ev_2 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_2 } var:oe_bey_m >= 97 var:oe_bey_m <= 348 has_variable = oe_bey_umur_dead var:oe_bey_umur_m <= 6 }
oe_bey_ok_3 = { oe_bey_ev_3 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_3 } var:oe_bey_m >= 97 var:oe_bey_m <= 348 oe_bey_ott_ok = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_void } OR = { NOT = { country_exists = c:KRD } AND = { country_exists = c:KRD c:KRD = { is_subject_of = c:TUR } } } OR = { location:canakkale = { owner ?= c:TUR } location:lapseki = { owner ?= c:TUR } location:can = { owner ?= c:TUR } location:bayramic = { owner ?= c:TUR } location:ayvacik = { owner ?= c:TUR } location:biga = { owner ?= c:TUR } } OR = { location:gallipoli = { owner ?= c:BYZ } location:enez = { owner ?= c:BYZ } location:hayrabolu = { owner ?= c:BYZ } location:malgara = { owner ?= c:BYZ } location:rodoscuk = { owner ?= c:BYZ } location:kesan = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } }

# BYZ scope. World steps: every country involved is AI and in place (who), and the step's premise (ok).
oe_bey_w1_who = { country_exists = c:AYD c:AYD = { is_ai = yes } country_exists = c:AYD character:ayd_umur ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:AYD } }
oe_bey_w1_ok = { oe_bey_w1_who = yes OR = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_latin location:smyrna = { owner ?= { religion = religion:catholic } } AND = { country_exists = c:KNI c:KNI = { has_variable = participated_in_smyrniote_crusade } } has_variable = oe_cw_pope } }
oe_bey_w2_who = { country_exists = c:AYD c:AYD = { is_ai = yes } OR = { country_exists = c:VEN country_exists = c:KNI } }
oe_bey_w2_ok = { oe_bey_w2_who = yes has_global_variable = oe_bey_w1 global_var:oe_bey_w1 = 1 }
oe_bey_w3_who = { country_exists = c:MEN c:MEN = { is_ai = yes } country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { is_ai = yes } location:balat = { owner ?= c:MEN } }
oe_bey_w3_ok = { oe_bey_w3_who = yes }
oe_bey_w4_who = { country_exists = c:SHP c:SHP = { is_ai = yes is_subject_of = c:GRM } country_exists = c:GRM c:GRM = { is_ai = yes at_war = no } }
oe_bey_w4_ok = { oe_bey_w4_who = yes }

# BYZ scope. The chronicle row (gen_chronicle.py, key bey). Void: the emirates were gone from before the empire's eyes
# before 1348 (design 4.4). Done: the line is closed (1446.1.1). Running: an event or a world step has happened, or a
# window has passed. Later phases add their own variables here; the chronicle row reads only these three.
oe_bey_chr_void = { has_variable = oe_bey_gone }
oe_bey_chr_done = { has_variable = oe_bey_off }
oe_bey_chr_run = {
    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_bey_done_1
        has_variable = oe_bey_done_2
        has_variable = oe_bey_done_3
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w1 global_var:oe_bey_w1 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w2 global_var:oe_bey_w2 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w3 global_var:oe_bey_w3 = 1 }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w4 global_var:oe_bey_w4 = 1 }
    }
}
